name: Nuoc mam Nam O
summary: Nước mắm Nam Ô is fish sauce from the village on the north shore, eaten as food, used as seasoning, and carried home as a gift.
origin: Nam Ô, the fish-sauce village on the north shore toward Hải Vân.
culture: Vietnamese visitors buy it for friends and family after a Da Nang trip.
howToEat: Use it as the seasoning, or carry a bottle home. The same village is tied to gỏi cá Nam Ô.
where: Nam Ô, on the shore toward Hải Vân.
seoTitle: Nuoc mam Nam O — Da Nang fish sauce
seoDescription: Nước mắm Nam Ô is fish sauce from Nam Ô, eaten as food, used as seasoning, and carried home as a gift.
